The '''Senate Building Reception Hall''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hosted a welcoming reception for the new cohort of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] under interim [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Padnel Ovin]]. Representatives of nearly every [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Alliance were gathered in the hall of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], and the arrival of the newly inducted Senator [[Abeloth|Rokari Kem]] commanded the greatest attention. Ovin was surprised by the luxuriousness of the event in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] reception area and asked his [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], about its cost. [[Service droid/Legends|Server droids]] distributed glasses of drinks such as sparkling [[Blumfruit juice/Legends|blumfruit juice]] to attendees.<ref name="Ascension" />
